impact_scope.description: Introduces the public plist_get_data_ptr callable, which returns a borrowed data-buffer pointer and writes its length through a caller-supplied output pointer.

evidence: S0 has no matching declaration for plist_get_data_ptr in the selected production files, so this newly introduced callable had no S0 exposure obligation.
S1 declares and implements plist_get_data_ptr(plist_t node, uint64_t* length).
H0 only invokes plist_from_bin or plist_from_xml and then plist_free; it never calls plist_get_data_ptr or supplies its required length output pointer.

new_harness_obligation.description: H0 must add a call to plist_get_data_ptr on a PLIST_DATA node and supply a uint64_t length output pointer to directly exercise the new public entry point and its borrowed-buffer behavior.
evidence: The callable did not exist in S0.
Direct exposure in S1 requires a new getter call with a caller-provided length pointer; the existing parser calls do not automatically invoke it.

reason: The anchored semantic unit is the newly introduced public plist_get_data_ptr API, not the older plist_get_data_val sibling or the separate string-pointer getter. Its own gap is false in S0 because the declaration is absent and true in S1 because unchanged H0 does not call it. This creates a concrete new harness call and output-argument obligation, yielding NEW and requiring maintenance.
